name: Nihon Minka-en

en.name: Nihon Minka-en
en.description: Open-air museum in Ikuta Ryokuchi, Kawasaki, displaying around 25 traditional Japanese houses from the Edo period, relocated from across the country and restored — thatched farmhouses, merchants' homes and storehouses. Many interiors can be viewed.
en.notes: Check current special exhibition schedules and arrive 15 minutes before opening.
en.reservation: Online advance ticket reservation recommended on weekends.

ja.name: 日本民家園
ja.description: 川崎市生田緑地内の野外博物館。日本各地から移築復元された江戸時代の民家約25棟が並び、茅葺きの農家や商家の内部も見学できる。
ja.reservation: 事前予約不要。現地にてチケットをご購入いただくか、自由にご見学いただけます。
ja.parking: 周辺の有料駐車場または公共駐車場をご利用いただけます。
